what: A sticker button stuck to the corner pops to 1.2× every 2.6 seconds to catch the eye (.1s grow, .16s return), and when pressed it is briefly squashed to 1.11× · −8° and returns

options.every: Bounce interval (sec), default 2.6 — 0 means it never bounces on its own
options.near: When given a distance (px), it does not pulse on its own, but repeats a two-beat throb (1.2x and 1.11x, rest .43s) only while the pointer is within that distance — faster the closer it gets (2.6x at the center). The original brand burger heart uses 520

from.where: Archive version (2026-10-21) plate burger heart (near: 520 — the closer the pointer, the faster it beats). The current original burger gathers twelve brush strokes into a heart on hover, then beats at 1.6x (site shared.js initHeart). The value once noted for a bottom-right sticker button was actually the burger heart’s beat in the original.

note: The original has a canvas character that moves along a path and bounces when pressed — we took the reduced version from the rebuild, a rounded square that bounces
